name: Frei Galvão
contribution: A Brazilian friar of the Franciscan Order.
legacy: He was the second Brazilian to be proclaimed a saint by the Catholic Church.

checks.lead: Anthony of St. Ann Galvão  (Portuguese: Antônio de Sant'Anna Galvão; 13 May 1739 – 23 December 1822), more commonly known as Frei Galvão, was a Brazilian friar of the Franciscan Order.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
